format: Every Competition OS event: judge-confirmed ballot corrections
requirement: DanceFlow policy (not a body rule): any alteration of a judge's marks needs the original adjudicator's authenticated confirmation bound to the replacement version and a hash of its marks; scorers and managers may only propose; the chair may authorize the workflow but never confirm; an unavailable judge means a hold with no override; scoring errors never change a ballot; originals, versions, reasons, identities and confirmations are immutable evidence.
interpretation_notes: Stricter than NDCA IV.C.7 and stronger than any WSDC or UCWDC text supplied, by owner decision OD-11. Applies to NDCA, UCWDC, WSDC, Studio and Custom events alike. Design only: nothing implemented, no test, no compliance claimed.
decision_refs: OD-11 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Option A; retrospective audit PR #795)
